data.body:
[P2] Preserve deadline processing for detached runners

Removing the runner from `participants` also excludes its pending waits/retries from deadline selection and `onClockAdvanced()` notifications. For example, a caller can race an invoke against a short wait, then await a separate callback that the invoked function sends after a one-hour durable wait. Previously that child's deadline advanced with `skipTime`; now only its real timer remains, so the caller's test times out. Abandoning the invoke result does not cancel the invoked execution or eliminate dependencies on its side effects. Separate clock-blocking participation from deadline processing, and add a regression test where the abandoned child resumes and delivers a callback.
